director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi

Chalo, main batati hoon. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao

Beech wale mark ka naam line ke 2 barabar gaps se aaya tha. Ab doosri taraf ke gaps gino, aur pehle mark ka naam usi tarah rakho. 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao
Haan, Hindi mein hi kehti hoon. Doosri taraf 3 gap bane hain. 0 se chala pehla gap jahan khatam hota hai, us mark ka naam batao, kis fraction ka hai?
director.card: Doosri taraf 3 gap bane hain. 0 se chala pehla gap jahan khatam hota hai, us mark ka naam batao, kis fraction ka hai?

seams.form: Haan, Hindi mein hi kehti hoon.

director.text: 1/3 hai na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 3 barabar gaps, pehla mark ek gap par: 1/3. Ab 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain. Neeche wala number gaps se aata hai: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/7 hai. Ab socho, doosri taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Us taraf kitne gaps banenge?
director.card: Ab socho, doosri taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Us taraf kitne gaps banenge?

director.text: pata nahi
Doosri taraf ke gaps ek-ek karke socho: marks ke beech wale bhi, aur 0 ke baad wala aur 1 se pehle wala bhi. 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks line ko barabar gaps mein baant-te hon, toh kitne gaps banenge?
director.card: Ab socho, doosri taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hon, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Us taraf kitne gaps banenge?

director.text: aath gaps

Bilkul sahi. Suno, marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: one tenth

Haan, bilkul theek: 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Is patti ko raasta samjho: baayan kinaara ghar, daayan kinaara school, aur beech ka kinaara beech wala khamba. Baaki do khambe board par nahi hain, unhe tumhe sochna hai. Ghar se school tak 1 kilometre ke raaste par 3 khambe barabar doori par hain; woh raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
pata nahi
Ghar se chalna shuru karo aur har gap par ek gino: khambon ke beech wale bhi, aur dono siron wale bhi. Ab tum batao.
haan
3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
mujhe nahi pata

3 khambe raaste ko 4 barabar gaps mein kaatte hain: ghar se pehle khambe tak ek gap, aur aakhri khambe se school tak bhi ek. Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/3 km

1/3 km sahi nahi hai. Ek aur dhang se samajhte hain. Darzi ka ribbon 0 se 1 metre tak hai, aur us par 4 chalk ke marks hain. Marks 4 hain, par gap 5 bante hain, isliye pehla mark 1/5 metre par hai. Socho, wahi ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaat rahe ho. Beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?
director.card: Socho, wahi ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaat rahe ho. Beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?

seams.form: Ek aur dhang se samajhte hain.

director.text: gyaarah

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 12 barabar gaps ke beech 11 marks hote hain, gaps se ek kam. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 1 kilometre ka raasta 4 barabar gaps mein hai; pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: 1/3 km
Nahi, 1/3 km theek nahi. Poora raasta 1 kilometre ka hai, aur woh 4 barabar gaps mein kata hai. Ek gap 1 kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, bas yahi socho. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/4 km

Bilkul sahi. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Ab agla sawaal tumhare liye. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 1/10 se baat nahi bani. 1/10 tab hota jab 0 se 1 ki line 10 barabar gaps mein hoti; par yahan 10 marks hain, aur 0 ke baad aur 1 se pehle bhi ek-ek gap hai. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, jo use barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 1/11 hai, kyunki 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
batting

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. 7 gaps wali taraf 0 se pehla gap dekho, aur dekho woh 1/5 wale mark se pehle khatam hota hai ya aage. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
